SELECT r.riskregistry, (r.txchainlen * 10 + r.linkedtxcount * 5 + r.fraudprob * 100 - r.profilecomplete * 0.5 - r.idverifyscore * 0.5) AS tcr, t.txregistry, t.payamtusd
FROM riskanalysis r
JOIN transactions t ON r.txref = t.txregistry
WHERE (r.txchainlen * 10 + r.linkedtxcount * 5 + r.fraudprob * 100 - r.profilecomplete * 0.5 - r.idverifyscore * 0.5) > 150 AND r.wallage < 30 AND r.wallturnrt > 5 AND r.linkedtxcount >= 3
ORDER BY tcr DESC

SELECT m.mktregistry, m.mktdenom, ROUND((m.dlyflow / 1000.0 + m.esccomprate * 0.2 + m.interscore * 0.3 + m.vendcount * 0.1 - m.mktspan / 100.0), 2) AS mrs
FROM markets m
ORDER BY mrs DESC

SELECT v.vendregistry, ROUND((v.vendrate * 10 + (v.vendsucccount * 1.0 / v.vendtxcount) * 50 + (CASE v.vendchecklvl WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1 WHEN 'Advanced' THEN 2 WHEN 'Premium' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) * 15 - (v.venddisputecount * 1.0 / v.vendtxcount) * 100), 2) AS vrs
FROM vendors v
WHERE v.vendtxcount > 0
ORDER BY vrs DESC

SELECT i.investregistry, ((CASE i.lawinterest WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'High' THEN 3 ELSE 2 END) * 30 + (CASE i.regrisklvl WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'High' THEN 3 ELSE 2 END) * 20 + r.fraudprob * 100 - i.compliancescore * 0.5 + i.notescount * 2) AS ips, i.lawinterest, t.txregistry
FROM investigation i
JOIN riskanalysis r ON i.riskref = r.riskregistry
JOIN transactions t ON r.txref = t.txregistry
JOIN markets m ON t.mktref = m.mktregistry
WHERE ((CASE i.lawinterest WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'High' THEN 3 ELSE 2 END) * 30 + (CASE i.regrisklvl WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'High' THEN 3 ELSE 2 END) * 20 + r.fraudprob * 100 - i.compliancescore * 0.5 + i.notescount * 2) > 200
  AND i.lawinterest = 'High'
  AND t.paymethod = 'Crypto_B'
  AND (t.escrowused = 'No' OR t.escrowhrs < 24)
  AND t.routecomplexity = 'Complex'
  AND ((t.payamtusd / 1000.0) * (t.txfinishhrs / 24.0) * (1 + t.escrowhrs / 100.0) * (1 - m.esccomprate / 100.0)) > 75
  AND m.vendcount > 100
  AND m.dlyflow > 5000
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM securitymonitoring s
              JOIN riskanalysis r2 ON s.riskref = r2.riskregistry
              JOIN transactions t2 ON r2.txref = t2.txregistry
              WHERE t2.mktref = m.mktregistry AND s.alertsev = 'High')
ORDER BY ips DESC

SELECT v.vendregistry, m.sizecluster, ((v.vendsucccount * 1.0 / v.vendtxcount) * 100 - (v.venddisputecount * 1.0 / v.vendtxcount) * 50 + v.vendrate * 5) AS vti, (COUNT(DISTINCT v.mktref) * 5 + v.vendtxcount / 50.0 + ((v.vendsucccount * 1.0 / v.vendtxcount) * 100 - (v.venddisputecount * 1.0 / v.vendtxcount) * 50 + v.vendrate * 5) * 0.1 - (1 - (CASE m.sizecluster WHEN 'Small' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Large' THEN 3 WHEN 'Mega' THEN 4 ELSE 0 END)) * 10) AS vnc
FROM vendors v
LEFT JOIN markets m ON v.mktref = m.mktregistry
GROUP BY v.vendregistry, m.sizecluster, v.vendtxcount, v.vendsucccount, v.venddisputecount, v.vendrate
HAVING vnc > 50
ORDER BY vnc DESC

SELECT t.txregistry, t.paymethod, t.payamtusd, t.escrowused, t.escrowhrs, t.routecomplexity, ((t.payamtusd / 1000.0) * (t.txfinishhrs / 24.0) * (1 + t.escrowhrs / 100.0) * (1 - m.esccomprate / 100.0)) AS tas
FROM transactions t
JOIN markets m ON t.mktref = m.mktregistry
WHERE ((t.payamtusd / 1000.0) * (t.txfinishhrs / 24.0) * (1 + t.escrowhrs / 100.0) * (1 - m.esccomprate / 100.0)) > 75
  AND t.paymethod = 'Crypto_B'
  AND (t.escrowused = 'No' OR t.escrowhrs < 24)
  AND t.routecomplexity = 'Complex'
ORDER BY tas DESC

SELECT m.mktregistry, m.mktdenom, m.mktclass,
       (m.mktspan / 365.0) * (m.esccomprate / 100.0)
       * (1 - CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(v.vendtxcount), 0) = 0 THEN 0
                   ELSE COALESCE(SUM(v.venddisputecount), 0) * 1.0 / SUM(v.vendtxcount) END) * 100 AS msi,
       json_extract(m.market_status_reputation, '$.status') AS current_status
FROM markets m
LEFT JOIN vendors v ON v.mktref = m.mktregistry
GROUP BY m.mktregistry, m.mktdenom, m.mktclass, m.mktspan, m.esccomprate, m.market_status_reputation
ORDER BY msi DESC

WITH c AS (
  SELECT commregistry, vpnflag, langpattern, msgtally,
         (CASE vpnflag WHEN 'Yes' THEN 1 WHEN 'Suspected' THEN 0.5 WHEN 'No' THEN 0 ELSE 0 END) AS vpn_num,
         (iptally * 5 + tornodecount * 2
          + (CASE vpnflag WHEN 'Yes' THEN 1 WHEN 'Suspected' THEN 0.5 WHEN 'No' THEN 0 ELSE 0 END) * 30
          + brwsrunique / 10.0 + susppatscore * 3 + riskindiccount * 4) AS csr
  FROM communication
), d AS (
  SELECT c.*,
         ((CASE langpattern WHEN 'Consistent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Variable' THEN 2 WHEN 'Suspicious' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) * 15
          + csr * 0.2 + msgtally * 0.5 - (1 - vpn_num) * 20) AS cpr
  FROM c
)
SELECT commregistry, vpnflag, langpattern, msgtally, ROUND(csr, 2) AS csr, ROUND(cpr, 2) AS cpr,
       CASE WHEN cpr > 70 AND langpattern = 'Suspicious' AND csr > 80
            THEN 'Deceptive Pattern' ELSE 'Normal Pattern' END AS pattern_classification
FROM d
ORDER BY cpr DESC

SELECT v.vendregistry, v.vendrate, v.mktref, ((v.vendsucccount * 1.0 / v.vendtxcount) * 100 - (v.venddisputecount * 1.0 / v.vendtxcount) * 50 + v.vendrate * 5) AS vti
FROM vendors v
WHERE ((v.vendsucccount * 1.0 / v.vendtxcount) * 100 - (v.venddisputecount * 1.0 / v.vendtxcount) * 50 + v.vendrate * 5) > 80
  AND v.vendchecklvl IN ('Advanced', 'Premium')
  AND (v.venddisputecount * 1.0 / v.vendtxcount) < 0.05
  AND v.vendspan > 90
ORDER BY vti DESC

SELECT commregistry,
       ((CASE vpnflag WHEN 'Yes' THEN 1 WHEN 'Suspected' THEN 0.5 WHEN 'No' THEN 0 ELSE 0 END) * 30
        + tornodecount * 2
        + (CASE encryptmethod WHEN 'Standard' THEN 1 WHEN 'Enhanced' THEN 2 WHEN 'Custom' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) * 15
        + connpatscore * 0.2 + brwsrunique / 20.0) AS apl
FROM communication
WHERE tornodecount > 20
ORDER BY apl DESC
